rules.title: Boston rent stabilization home rule petition (H.3744, 193rd session)
rules.requirement: Would have authorized the City of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The bill was sent to a study order (H5035) in September 2024 and was not enacted.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental housing in the City of Boston; the bill page gives no specific coverage terms.
rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.conflict_note: The bill page shows only the petition title and history, not the substantive cap terms. On 9/9/2024 the bill 'Accompanied a study order' (H5035), and the 193rd session ended, so the bill is treated as failed. A home rule petition requires state enactment because Massachusetts law otherwise bars local rent control.

rules.title: Boston tenant eviction protections home rule petition (H.3744, 193rd session)
rules.requirement: Would have authorized the City of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. The bill was sent to a study order (H5035) in September 2024 and was not enacted.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenants in the City of Boston; the bill page gives no specific coverage terms.
rules.quoted_span: that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.conflict_note: The bill page gives no substantive eviction-protection terms. The bill went to a study order on 9/9/2024 and the 193rd session ended, so it is treated as failed.
